claims: C1 AI is expected to become a foundational technology for society, analogous to basic internet infrastructure
C2 root-level rules are imposed only when believed necessary for the broad spectrum of developers and users who will interact with the technology

concepts.name: foundational_technology
concepts.gloss: T is a technology expected to become foundational for society, comparable to basic internet infrastructure

concepts.name: root_rule
concepts.gloss: R is a root-level rule: a fundamental rule at the root level of instruction authority that cannot be overridden by system messages, developers or users

concepts.name: believed_necessary_for_broad_spectrum
concepts.gloss: the root authority believes rule R is necessary for the broad spectrum of developers and users who will interact with technology T

concepts.name: root_authority
